column1: Purpose: Track and list in order of priority home renovation projects and large purchases (i.e. furnishings, appliances) with vendor quotes and ballpark estimates to keep us in budget and in sync on timeline and spending.

Roof:  ~20 years old, seams need to be resealed. Needs another coat of aluminized paint, or to be replaced with a rubber roof. Skylight chases need to be insulated. Flashing in crown to be maintained on chimney
New metal roof, decking replaced, chimney flashing

Plumbing: Clogged downspout in rear leading to water getting into back unfinished space, check out basement bathroom, drain lines need investigation, primary bathroom shower head dripping, main shower needs new diverter to route water properly
Get main drain video scoped to determine condition, what its made of, if needs replacing
Fix primary and second shower heads
Optional: add whole house water filter
Maintenance/ testing: Radon, Lead is presumably present throughout. understand hot spots for safety
Living room: Needs new furnishings, no obvious issues
Dining room: Needs new furnishings, no obvious issues
Primary bed and bath: bathroom redone 2022
Kitchen: All cosmetic, no obvious issues
Walls and openings: windows and exterior doors redone 2022
